180 days to regain compliance, through May 24, 2027
The deadline creates a defined period to restore the bid price and avoid further listing consequences.
ADSs must close at $1.00+ for 10 consecutive business days
This is the stated price threshold for regaining compliance; no current bid price was provided.
ADSs remain listed; no immediate delisting or suspension
Trading continues for now, though the deficiency remains unresolved.
